data.description: A modern community in Dubailand, promoting a connection to nature and enhancing well-being.

data.answer:
Sun City by DAMAC Properties is an upcoming gated off-plan development in Dubailand, featuring well-designed residences that blend modern architecture with high-quality finishes. The community will emphasize open spaces and beautifully landscaped gardens, creating a serene environment for future residents. 

Strategically located near Emirates Road (E611) and Al Qudra Road (D63), the sub-community offers convenient access to key areas of Dubai, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a peaceful yet well-connected lifestyle.

DAMAC Sun City offers spacious 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses, making it one of the most family-friendly communities in Dubai. These townhouses will range in size from 2,319 sq. ft. to 3,323 sq. ft. and feature expansive living areas, floor-to-ceiling windows, fitted kitchens, powder rooms, and ample storage. 

Each bedroom will include an attached bathroom and walk-in closet for added convenience. The interiors combine natural elements with modern design, featuring warm wooden accents, contemporary tiling, and large windows to create a harmonious and comfortable living environment.

Buying a Property in DAMAC Sun City

Buying a property in DAMAC Sun City offers a unique opportunity to invest in Dubailand’s latest family-friendly community. With prices starting from AED 2.8 million, these 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses provide modern designs, spacious layouts, and exclusive amenities.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in DAMAC Sun City in Dubailand?

data.answer:
The extensive amenities in DAMAC Sun City Dubailand ensure a vibrant community experience tailored for families and professionals alike.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in DAMAC Sun City

Every home in the community will feature dedicated parking spaces. As for transportation, DAMAC Sun City is still in the development phase, so there are no transportation options within the neighborhood as of now.

Supermarkets Around DAMAC Sun City

Residents of the Sun City will have easy access to many supermarkets in the master Dubailand community. The most popular options are Spinneys and West Zone Supermarket.

Schools Near DAMAC Sun City

For families in DAMAC Sun City, there are several reputable schools nearby, making it ideal for those with older children. Fairgreen International School in The Sustainable City is 1.9 km, whereas GEMS Metropole School Al Waha is 2.1 km from the community.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near DAMAC Sun City

The Mudon Mosque is approximately a 12-minute drive away, while the Al Madinah Al Mustadama Mosque in The Sustainable City is about 14 minutes by car.

For Christian residents, the Emirates Baptist Church and St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church are located roughly 20 minutes away. Hindu worshippers can visit the Shirdi Sai Baba Temple, approximately a 20-minute drive.

Clinics and Hospitals Near DAMAC Sun City

Health Connect Clinic is approximately a 23-minute drive away, HealthHub Clinic in Dubai Silicon Oasis is about 25 minutes by car, and Dubai London Clinic is reachable within 27 minutes.

Location & Nearby Areas

The Sun City community in Dubailand offers residents a prime location with convenient access to key areas in Dubai. It is just 15 minutes away from popular neighborhoods like Dubai Sports City, Motor City, and DAMAC Hills. 

For business and logistics, Dubai Investment Park is a short 20-minute drive. At the same time, travel is made easy with Al Maktoum International Airport just 23 minutes away and Dubai International Airport within a 28-minute reach.

more_info.question: Things to Do in DAMAC Sun City, Dubailand

data.answer:
Sun City is set to be one of the most family-friendly communities in Dubai, so rest assured there will be plenty of fun things to do for the residents.

Restaurants

Living in DAMAC Sun City offers the convenience of having a range of dining options close by. Just a 10-minute drive away, PRATO Dubai, located at the Trump International Golf Club, provides an upscale Italian culinary experience with picturesque golf course views. 

For a more relaxed vibe, 71 Sports Bar is another great choice within the same venue, ideal for casual dining and enjoying a drink while watching live sports.

Beaches Near DAMAC Sun City

While DAMAC Sun City is an inland community in Dubailand, residents can access several of Dubai's renowned beaches within a reasonable drive. Jumeirah Public Beach, known for its pristine sands and clear waters, is approximately a 30-minute drive away.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

The luxury villas in Dubailand's Sun City by DAMAC Properties are designed to offer residents an active and wellness-focused lifestyle. The community will feature a range of outdoor activities and fitness facilities, ensuring a balanced and healthy living environment. Here are some of the standout amenities that will be available:

  • Open-air co-working space for professionals who enjoy working amidst nature.
  • Grand water fountain and an organic world with botanical treasures, perfect for relaxation.
  • Forest hiking trail with a suspended bridge offering scenic views of lush greenery.
  • Ice bath station and outdoor sauna cabins for wellness therapy and detoxification.
  • Outdoor camping area and a wild garden amphitheater for unique recreational experiences.
  • Tennis courts, outdoor yoga spaces, and a sunrise gym for fitness enthusiasts.
  • Monkey bar arena for fun and challenging physical activities.

These facilities will make Sun City a top choice for those seeking an active lifestyle within a serene setting.

Community Events

The Sun City will bring the community together with vibrant events, from outdoor movie nights under the stars to seasonal festivals that celebrate the spirit of togetherness. It's a place where neighbors become friends through shared experiences.

Attractions and Landmarks

Among the nearby attractions and landmarks, the Arabian Ranches Golf Club is just an 18-minute drive away, offering a premier golfing experience amid stunning landscapes. For those seeking shopping and leisure, Town Square is only 10 minutes away, providing a range of retail outlets, cafes, and family-friendly activities.

When considering a home in DAMAC Sun City, you'll find it offers a blend of modern amenities and serene green spaces, perfect for families and individuals seeking a balanced lifestyle. With its strategic location in Dubailand, residents will enjoy easy access to key areas of Dubai while living in a peaceful, gated community designed for comfort and convenience.

more_info.question: FAQs About Sun City DAMAC Properties

data.answer:
Will Sun City offer any exclusive wellness programs for its residents?

Absolutely! The community is designed with wellness in mind, featuring outdoor yoga spaces, sunrise gym sessions, and detoxifying sauna cabins to promote a healthy lifestyle.

What kind of payment plans are available for purchasing a home in Sun City?

DAMAC Properties offers flexible 75/25 payment plans for Sun City, with options like installment schedules that extend until the project’s handover in Q1 2028, making it easier for buyers to invest.

Will there be dedicated retail spaces within the community?

Yes, Sun City will feature a dedicated retail zone with convenience stores, cafes, and essential services to cater to the daily needs of its residents without having to leave the community.

data.content:
DAMAC Sun City is set to be one of the best communities in Dubailand, offering a collection of 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses with modern amenities designed to enhance everyday living. Scheduled for completion by Q1 2028, this off-plan development by DAMAC Properties is focused on delivering beautifully designed homes surrounded by lush landscapes. Residents will enjoy a serene environment that promotes wellness through thoughtfully planned spaces and calm zones.

The master plan of DAMAC Sun City in Dubailand will feature an array of exclusive amenities to create a vibrant community atmosphere. Future residents can look forward to unique features like an open-air co-working space and a grand water fountain that will serve as a central attraction. Additionally, the organic world section will showcase a curated selection of botanical treasures, adding a touch of nature's elegance to the neighborhood.

Investing in DAMAC Sun City Dubailand offers a promising future with its commitment to providing a holistic lifestyle experience. The community will be enriched with wellness-oriented facilities like an ice bath station, outdoor camping areas, and a wild garden amphitheater, catering to both relaxation and recreation. With its strategic location and exceptional amenities, Sun City presents a compelling opportunity for those looking to invest in one of Dubailand’s most anticipated communities.
